replies.author: Rainstruck
replies.body: Love the concept of it. Maybe add a middle island so that people can bridge to something else rather than the other side, but overall, +1.
replies.body_tagged: Love the concept of it. Maybe add a middle island so that people can bridge to something else rather than the other side, but overall, +1.

replies.author: Vobaseball12
replies.body:
Looks: Wow! I really was impressed with the colors and how they went together. The shape of the map does not only look good, but it actually contributes to the gameplay too.

Gameplay: Like mentioned above, the shape is actually a big factor. If anything was to change, I'd like to have you swap the little bedrock wall and the soulsand with the sandstone wall.

This map looks like it could be a very good one. +1
